settings.title: Metrics settings
settings.intro: The calendar and thresholds every flow-metrics report is derived against. A save applies to the whole unit.

field.hoursPerDayHint: Converts logged worklog seconds to man-days.
field.agingPercentilesHint: Must include 85 (the data-quality overview reads it by name).
field.epicEstimateGapTolerancePercentHint: How far an epic's own estimate may differ from its tasks' total before Data quality and Home flag it.
field.historyHorizonEnabledHint: Work older than the horizon is left out of the reports. Stored data is kept, so raising the horizon brings it back.

settings.holidaysNote: Public holidays are always non-working days. They have their own list, not a setting here.
settings.saveForbidden: Only administrators can edit metrics settings
settings.saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid

validation.hoursPerDay: Hours per day must be greater than 0 and at most 24
validation.timeZone: Must be a valid time zone, e.g. Europe/Warsaw
validation.weekendDaysInvalid: Weekend days must each be Monday .. Sunday
validation.weekendDaysAllWeek: Weekend days must not mark every day of the week as non-working
validation.commitmentGraceMinutes: Commitment grace must be 0 or more
validation.minSampleSize: Minimum sample size must be at least 1
validation.agingWindowItems: Aging-WIP window must be at least 1
validation.agingPercentilesEmpty: At least one aging percentile is required
validation.agingPercentilesRange: Aging percentiles must each be a whole number between 1 and 99
validation.agingPercentilesDuplicate: Aging percentiles must not contain duplicates
validation.backlogWindowSprints: Backlog window must be at least 1 sprint
validation.epicDriftDays: Epic drift threshold must be 0 or more
validation.epicEstimateGapTolerancePercent: Epic estimate gap tolerance must be a whole percent between 0 and 100
validation.historyHorizonMonths: History horizon must be a whole number of months between {{min}} and {{max}}

teamMembers.title: Jira members
teamMembers.pickPerson: Search people by name or account id…
teamMembers.peopleCut: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} people — type a name or account id to narrow the list
teamMembers.directoryCut: Only the first {{shown}} of {{total}} people could be loaded to name the members — the rest show their account id
teamMembers.zoneUnavailable: The metrics time zone could not be loaded, so membership dates cannot be saved yet.

field.validToHint: Leave blank for an open-ended (current) membership.

teamMembers.emptyHint: An administrator can add them one by one or seed them from the Jira Team field.
teamMembers.removeFailed: Could not remove the membership row
teamMembers.removeBody: This membership row for {{name}} will be permanently removed.
teamMembers.addOverlap: This person already has a membership covering that period — end or edit the existing one first.
teamMembers.addAccountUnknown: This Jira account is not known to any connection yet.
teamMembers.endConflict: This period now overlaps another membership row.
teamMembers.endInvalid: Could not end this membership — it may already have ended.

validation.validFromInvalid: Valid from must be an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)
validation.validToInvalid: Valid to must be an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)
validation.validToBeforeFrom: Valid to must be after valid from

teamSeed.title: Seed members from the Jira Team field
teamSeed.intro: Pick an Atlassian team. The people assigned to its issues are offered as members, each starting on the day of their earliest issue for that team.
teamSeed.noTeams: No Atlassian team has been seen on an issue yet
teamSeed.noCandidates: Nobody is assigned to issues of this team

field.teamHint: The number of issues carrying the team is shown in brackets.

teamSeed.tableAria: People assigned to the team's issues
teamSeed.hint: Memberships are open-ended and start on the first issue's day — or, for someone who left another team after that day, on the day they left it. People with a current (open) membership are shown but cannot be selected.
teamSeed.tooMany: At most {{max}} people can be seeded at once — untick some.

error.conflict: A membership changed in the meantime — close this dialog and open it again.
error.invalid: The selection is not valid — close this dialog and open it again.

config.notConfiguredBanner: Showing computed defaults — save to confirm them
config.loadFailedGeneric: Could not load the metrics configuration
config.saveForbidden: Only administrators can edit the metrics configuration
config.saveConflict: This team is already mapped to another board
config.saveFailedGeneric: Could not save the metrics configuration

statuses.stageHint: Waiting is a queue: waiting for review, test or deploy. Blocked is an impediment: blocked, on hold, waiting for a customer. Both count as work in progress but never as active time. Jira's Flagged marker still marks an item as blocked whatever its status.

workflow.hint: Which workflow uses the status: the epic issue types' (Epic), the other issue types' (Task), or both. No badge: the status belongs only to a type above epic level, or the split is unknown.

statuses.showAllHint: By default only statuses used by this connection's workflows or seen in its history are listed, plus any you changed. Saving always covers every status.
statuses.empty: No statuses observed yet — sync this connection first.

overrides.title: Per-domain overrides
overrides.hint: A status can mean a different stage in one domain than everywhere else. Choose a domain, then set a stage only for the statuses that differ — every other status keeps the stage in the table above.
overrides.summaryNone: No overrides: every domain uses the stages above.
overrides.noDomains: No domains yet — define them on the Domains tab first.
overrides.orphanError: "{{domain}}" is no longer a domain, so its overrides cannot be saved. Remove them or restore the domain key.
overrides.removeAria: Remove the override for {{name}} in domain {{domain}}
overrides.orphanStatus: Status {{status}} is no longer reported by this connection, so its override in domain {{domain}} ({{stage}}) cannot be saved. Remove it to save.
overrides.removeOrphanStatusAria: Remove the override for unknown status {{status}} in domain {{domain}}

fields.showAllHint: By default only the fields in your projects' field scheme are listed, plus any field you selected.
fields.schemeUnknownHint: The field scheme isn't available from Jira (the optional Field configuration scope may be missing), so only fields that have data in the synced issues are listed.
